mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS scenic_id, s.name AS scenic_name, s.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS collection_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS comment_count, s.score, ROUND(s.view_count * 0.5 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 2 + s.score * 10, 2) AS heat_score, sc.name AS category_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.view_count DESC) AS rank_num FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS scenic_id, s.name AS scenic_name, s.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS collection_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS comment_count, s.score, ROUND(s.view_count * 0.5 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 2 + s.score * 10, 2) AS heat_score, sc.name AS category_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) DESC) AS rank_num FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY collection_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS scenic_id, s.name AS scenic_name, s.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS collection_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS comment_count, s.score, ROUND(s.view_count * 0.5 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 2 + s.score * 10, 2) AS heat_score, sc.name AS category_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) DESC) AS rank_num FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY comment_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenic WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM view_record vr WHERE vr.user_id = u.id) AS view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id) AS collection_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post fp WHERE fp.user_id = u.id) AS forum_post_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM view_record vr WHERE vr.user_id = u.id) * 1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id) * 2 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id) * 2 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post fp WHERE fp.user_id = u.id) * 3 AS activity_score, (SELECT MAX(create_time) FROM user_comment WHERE user_id = u.id) AS last_active_time, u.status FROM user u WHERE u.role = 0 ORDER BY activity_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM view_record WHERE view_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role = 0 AND status = #{status}

SELECT s.id AS scenic_id, s.name AS scenic_name, s.recommend_level * 10 AS recommend_count, s.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) AS collection_count, ROUND(s.view_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.recommend_level * 10, 0), 2) AS view_rate, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.recommend_level * 10, 0), 2) AS collection_rate, ROUND(s.view_count * 0.4 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 0.6, 2) AS effect_score FROM scenic s WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.recommend_level > 0 ORDER BY effect_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT AVG(view_rate) FROM ( SELECT ROUND(s.view_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.recommend_level * 10, 0), 2) AS view_rate FROM scenic s WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.recommend_level > 0 ) AS rates

SELECT AVG(collection_rate) FROM ( SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collection uc WHERE uc.target_id = s.id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.recommend_level * 10, 0), 2) AS collection_rate FROM scenic s WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.recommend_level > 0 ) AS rates
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenic WHERE status = 1 AND recommend_level > 0
